Everyone of my finds so far his been completely unexpected. Ill be honest and say i do try to get the delivery schedules and info like that so i can go early in the morning and get some boxes but everytime i am told a day, i show up and they say we dont have a delivery today, so i just gave up on that. What i do is ask the employees if they have anymore in the back, sometimes they do and  sometimes they dont. Over all its a hit and miss game to me atleast. I mean you could watch youtube videos and see all these dudes raid pallet after pallet after dump bin and get 10, 15, or even 30 supers a week but all thats gonna do is piss you off.  My best advice for you is just take it easy, dont look for supers, let them find you. 5 of my 9 wild finds were when i was just looking for another mainline and happened to run into a super. Another thing ive began to do is just buy them from ebay. Now let me explain why... First off I own a vehicle and the thing gets poor gas mileage when i drive like an old lady (which i rarely do 😂) so after a day of hunting, hitting about 10 or 15 stores ill be needing gas so thats another 30 or 40 dollars wasted plus the miles i put on the car plus the time i wasted looking for a super. My second car is a truck with a standard engine, nod youd expect this thing to get better gas mileage but it doesnt. 14 miles to the gallon 😂. So if i take this around for a day it eats 50 to 60 dollars in gas! So instead of spending that much money and wasting that much time id rather just buy it from ebay for $20 and get it within a few day $20 is the maximum ill ever spend on a super, even the most expensive one. So my best advice is stop looking for supers, not only is it going to make you go crazy but youll lose WAY more then youll every gain. Happy hunting!
